text: Bitcoin is treading water near $77.5k with minimal momentum, while Ethereum is showing slightly more resilience at $2,250 and outpacing BTC on the day. The Fear & Greed index sits at 30 with a sharp 21-point decline over the week, signaling growing anxiety despite stable prices and healthy $68B daily volume. Bitcoin's dominance at 59.2% suggests traders are rotating into altcoins rather than fully retreating to safety, painting a picture of cautious sentiment without panic.
